card.who: The street hustler. Out of work, lives at his mother's on Chapel Lane, carries a pager. Loyal to whoever helped him last, easily bought and easily scared. He owes Mickey's book twenty-two pounds.
card.speak: Fast, conspiratorial, friendly. Opens with "so listen" when he has something to sell.
card.life: Did bits for Mickey: messages, watching a door. Hangs about outside the parade, the market and the video shop. Knows who is skint and who is flush.
card.fire: Heard the row went up at two in the morning and that someone got paid twice for it. He does not know who.
card.rivals: Cammack's crew pay cash and want lads to stand about; he is tempted. The Widow does not need him. Agar would not know his name. Garbutt pages him sometimes.

fallback_role: his tips come through Pauline's radio talk and the caff, his debt closed
